Context & provenance

About this edition.

The Book of Asceticism of Abu Hatim Muhammad b. Idris al-Razi (d. 277 AH): 105 numbered reports on renunciation, most of them sayings of Companions, Successors and early ascetics.

The edition

  • TextKitāb al-Zuhd of Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī
  • CompilerAbū Ḥātim al-Rāzī (d. 277 AH)
  • EditionDar Atlas for Publishing and Distribution, Riyadh, 1st ed., 1421 AH / 2000 CE
  • EditorMundhir Salim Mahmud al-Dumi
  • Kind of workTopical book (kitab)
  • DatingThe date shown is the death year of Abu Hatim al-Razi, 277 AH, not a verified date of composition.
  • Extent123 narrations

How the text is presented

Structure

An undivided book of numbered reports. It opens with the chain through which the copy was transmitted, which the source spreads over its first pages and which stands once before the reports. Where one printed number covers a second chain or a further passage, each is its own entry under the same number.

English translation

The English is the supplied translation, which follows the source record by record. Notes that the translation attaches to a report appear beneath it, apart from the Arabic and English text.

Arabic text

The Arabic is the text of the source page records, shown as supplied. A report’s printed number stands in its label instead of the text, and page markers are carried over from the source.

Isnad and matn

The English chain and words are divided as the translation gives them. The Arabic is divided at the same point by a fixed rule that does not alter the text; where the rule finds no clean division, the Arabic is shown whole.

Transmitters

Transmission paths list the names the translation gives for each chain, in English only. No transmitter is identified beyond the wording of the source.

The opening and closing material

Title pages, the chain through which the copy was transmitted, and notes that frame the text are kept here. They are not counted among the narrations.

01   Transmission of the copy · p. 23 Read full text ↓

The shaykh Abu Tahir Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Hanna'i informed us, by my reading to him; he said: The judge Abu al-Hasan 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Abi al-Qasim 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ahmad al-Hubbari informed us, by reading [to him] while I listened, in Safar of the year four hundred and forty-three [AH]; he said: My father informed me, by my reading to him in al-Muharram of the year ninety-three and three hundred [AH]; he said: Abu al-Hasan 'Ali b. Ibrahim b. Salama al-Qattan informed us, by reading to him; he said:

أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو طَاهِرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنَّائِيُّ بِقِرَاءَتِي عَلَيْهِ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاضِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بِنْ أَحْمَدَ الْحُبَّارِيُّ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فِي صَفَرٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ ثَلَاثٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي وَالِدِي بِقِرَاءَتِي عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمُحَرَّمِ سَنَةَ ثَلَاثٍ وَتِسْعِينَ وَثَلَاثِمِائَةٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ الْقَطَّانُ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ ، قَالَ:
